latest_release.name: v4.3.5
latest_release.body:
> [!WARNING]
> We live in the era of big tech companies buying out OSS project maintainers left and right. Vuetify stays independent as long as community keeps the funds flowing to the OpenCollective. Our team is putting hundreds of hours in to keep the project going:
> - troubleshoot and fix top priority bugs as quickly as possible
> - review incoming PRs
> - deliver new features
> - maintain ecosystem tools
>
> If Vuetify is part of your stack, please consider [sponsoring the project](https://opencollective.com/vuetify) so we can continue delivering updates and fixes.
>
> Every contribution helps us keep Vuetify alive and signals to maintainers that their work matters.
>
> Thank you.

---

### :wrench: Bug Fixes

* **locale:** correct Persian aria labels and calendar text ([#23426](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/issues/23426)) ([d5e75e3](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/commit/d5e75e3e4751a9608fdecd5b38075e9cb5c90a6b))
* **locale:** correct Hebrew translations for sort labels and carousel ([#23427](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/issues/23427)) ([85be95d](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/commit/85be95d829a4365a478c35efa793071823333cf4))
* **VBtnGroup:** override custom colors in forced-colors mode ([#23425](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/issues/23425)) ([4468db1](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/commit/4468db1fc45220dcd73f70650072170114a1ab6d))
* **VBtnGroup:** keep borders when a button is disabled ([209cbcd](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/commit/209cbcd9fbfb257a72aa247cc6f105b8db52df73)), closes [#23376](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/issues/23376)
* **VCalendar:** allow scrolling in category view ([#23413](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/issues/23413)) ([e1816d6](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/commit/e1816d6fc3cd4c7d79222700be82278188c944a3)), closes [#22537](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/issues/22537)
* **VFileInput:** respect form state and reject drop and paste ([#23430](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/issues/23430)) ([b506d3f](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/commit/b506d3ff13bbf9cb17cbd1ea186beba72eb210f4))
* **VOverlay:** respect zIndex when opened from other overlay ([#23414](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/issues/23414)) ([b768f0b](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/commit/b768f0b817510e20960a3b2c124e496c9b23a4ca)), closes [#16251](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/issues/16251)
* **VProgressCircular:** use correct color in forced-colors mode ([7bf6c0d](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/commit/7bf6c0dfe19bce66753f10b01d9346f904167b0c))


### :test_tube: Labs

* **VMonthPicker:** format year in view mode toggle ([4273ee4](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/commit/4273ee4d1f1fbd668ba75c32d78d234b55bda1a2))
